scope: Local retrospective audit; existing trajectories only. No simulator, flight, remote host or Thor.
training: Exactly the 18 P11 NORMAL/A/B full trajectories in h2_strict_singles.json; no AB or REPAIR trajectories or P13 outcomes used in fitting.
baseline_EE: Ordinary nonlinear grey-box state-space dynamics with the same 10 coefficients, parameter bounds, source controller, event rules, motor filter, state and clocks. Independently assemble equation-error regression from raw training measurements and independently implement plant integrator. Bounded least squares. The hypothesis that the proposed model is this ordinary grey box is allowed to be confirmed.
baseline_OE: Additional ordinary multi-step output-error nonlinear least squares: fixed 64ms plant response windows from the same full trajectories, measured commands only in training, all source controller and event rules at test time. Initial coefficients from EE; no held-out outcome tuning. Fit to velocity and angular velocity endpoints with fixed scales 0.1m/s and0.2rad/s. Every16th eligible fresh-LP sample starts a window. Maximum80 function evaluations. This is an additional retained baseline, not a replacement chosen on AB scores.
evaluation: All18 P13 AB cases. Primary: same per-case pre-stream initial states as prior strict comparison. Sensitivity: known NORMAL initial-state templates, matched to sequential-budget audit. Report both per-case and group-map means, never mix them.

ablations.full: Full semantics and all inherited state.
ablations.hold_target: Keep packet absence, source network, physical model and clocks, but replace timeout/capture target semantics by last-received-target zero-order hold. No recapture at timeout.
ablations.no_carry: At the B-start seam replace all predictive state by the same-time state of a no-A nominal rollout from exactly the same initial condition. Preserve observed-in-model prefix metrics and failure history. No measured B-pre state. This is an information-deletion ablation, not a proposed physical reset or a fair full-information baseline.
ablations.hold_target_no_carry: Factorial combination of the preceding two deletions.
ablations.no_neural_carry: Replace only h/previous/history/count at the seam by their no-A predicted values; preserve physical, event and clock states.
ablations.no_physical_carry: Replace p/v/q/omega/motor/filter/pending and observation caches at the seam by no-A predicted values; preserve controller and event states.

metrics: Task classification on18; height MAE on fixed13 complete cases; tilt MAE on same13; witnessed-failure false negatives and known-safe false positives; domain exits count. Do not treat censored values as exact peak heights. Per-block top-risk choices retained but failure-finding superiority not inferred from map accuracy.
interpretation: Ablation benefits establish the need for components inside a model; ordinary grey-box models with the same components receive those benefits too. Novel algorithm contribution requires improvement over the full-information grey-box baseline.
limitations: Data were already inspected during prior method development; no prospective independence. Deterministic model forecasts, overlapping records, limited conditions. Frozen source clocks are approximate. No global error guarantee. No new switching or cross-platform claim.
